Verify the slot icons render at full colour. Regression for the 2026-08-15 report (icon greyed out after the switch to type="spell"). 1. Root cause 1 (the blocking one): Disenchant/Prospecting/Milling live on PROFESSION skill lines, not the Player spell bank Wise:IsActionKnown scans, and IsPlayerSpell returns false for them. An unknown action is desaturated at GUI.lua isValid AND — in a dynamic group — dropped from the bar entirely, and UpdateButtonUsability early-returns on isValid==false so no later fix can run. Fixed by actionData.alwaysKnown, applied at BOTH IsActionKnown call sites and at the isValid computation. 2b. Root cause 2: Disenchant/Prospecting/Milling are spell-TARGETING casts. C_Spell.IsSpellUsable returns false whenever nothing is on the targeting cursor — i.e. always, until the click — so UpdateButtonUsability dimmed the icon permanently. Fixed by actionData.alwaysUsable, which makes the usability pass skip the spell check for these actions. 3. Root cause 2: the action stored the localized spell NAME. Wise:IsActionKnown resolves a name back to an ID via C_Spell.GetSpellInfo, which is unreliable for profession/salvage spells; a failed resolve set isValid=false and desaturated the icon before the usability pass ever ran. The action now stores the numeric spell ID. 4. Confirm the slot still CASTS correctly (the icon change must not have broken target-bag/target-slot). 5. Confirm ordinary spell slots on other interfaces still grey out correctly when genuinely unusable (out of range, no resource, not known) — alwaysUsable must apply ONLY to actions that set it. 6. Confirm the icon is the queued ITEM icon, not the spell icon.
